caption: A candle is carried behind a paper screen in a dark room, and a soft glow travels across the screen with it.

sa.check: A paper screen stands in a room.
A candle is carried behind it.
A glow travels across the screen with it.

pc.expect: The glow moves with the candle and only then, flickering with it.
pc.fail: It moves with the candle still; or stays put while the candle moves; or pulses with a steady flame.

pc.expect: The glow is brightest opposite the flame and fades outward, and the screen is dark where the candle is not.
pc.fail: The whole screen glows evenly; or the brightest spot is far from the candle; or the screen glows with the candle gone.

pc.expect: The glow is one soft patch through the paper.
pc.fail: It is a sharp spot; or splits; or is a geometric shape.
It points down or sideways; or detaches; or floats.
A second glow appears with one candle; or the screen vanishes; or the candle passes through the paper.

pc.expect: The screen and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The screen changes colour; or the room rearranges; or the candle changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
